title: Adobe India Hackathon 2025
description: Multi-round hackathon by Adobe, exclusively on Unstop. Theme: reimagining PDFs as intelligent, interactive experiences. Grand Finale at Adobe HQ, Noida. Open to B.Tech/M.Tech students graduating 2026–2029. Teams of 2–3.

title: Hackground India 2K25
description: Student-led hackathon at Maharaja Surajmal Institute (MSI), New Delhi. Open-ended innovation challenge for engineering students across disciplines.

title: PKP Mumbai Hackathon 2025
description: Programmers Ka Parivar presents an in-person community hackathon in Mumbai. Collaborative coding event focused on building practical solutions.

title: HackIndia 2025 — UP West Regionals
description: Regional node of HackIndia 2025 hosted at Lloyd Institute of Engineering & Technology, Greater Noida. Part of the national HackIndia circuit.

title: ET AI Hackathon 2.0
description: Economic Times flagship nation-scale innovation challenge. Multi-phase journey focused on Applied AI, prototype development, and scalable business/social innovation. Open to students and professionals.

title: HackOn with Amazon 6.0
description: Elite software development challenge for engineering students by Amazon. Focus on AI Engineering and large-scale coding. Pre-Placement Interview opportunities for top performers.

title: Bharatiya Antariksh Hackathon 2025
description: ISRO's national innovation challenge, powered by Hack2Skill. 14 real problem statements from India's space missions — AI/ML, Geospatial Tech, Image Processing. Grand Finale: 30-hour sprint at NRSC, Hyderabad. Registration deadline: Jul 9. Internship opportunities at ISRO for top teams.

title: Hyperspace Innovation Hackathon 2026
description: Deep-tech 36-hour hackathon at IPEC Ghaziabad, powered by Hack2Skill with Microsoft and AWS support. Problem statements inspired by ISRO & DRDO. Tracks: SpaceTech, DroneTech, AI Systems, Robotics, Smart Cities, Sustainability, Open Innovation.

title: AMD Slingshot — National AI Startup Challenge
description: National startup idea challenge for student innovators, powered by AMD and Hack2Skill. Across 10 cities. Gain mentorship, funding support, and compete for prizes. Focus: Ryzen AI innovation.

title: India Connected: APIs for a Billion Lives
description: In-person hackathon by GSMA on HackerEarth. Build API-powered solutions across 5 theme areas addressing India's real-world challenges using Open Gateway APIs. Open to developers, startups, and innovators aged 18+. Participants must attend in person.

title: Thales GenTech India Hackathon 2025
description: 2nd edition of Thales' national hackathon on HackerEarth. Single-challenge format. Themes: Cybersecurity, Inclusive EdTech, AI for Social Impact, Aerospace/Aviation. Solo or teams up to 5. Open to all in India (not Thales employees).
prize: Cash prizes + Job opportunities at Thales

title: SuRaksha Cyber Hackathon 2.0
description: Campus-focused cybersecurity hackathon by Canara Bank on HackerEarth. Build behavior-based authentication systems for mobile banking. Focus: real-time fraud detection, password-less login, data privacy in fintech. Students only.

title: Capital One Launchpad 2025
description: Capital One's flagship AI/ML innovation challenge in India on HackerEarth. Focus: Agentic AI prototypes for the agriculture sector. Empower farmers with intelligent, data-driven decision-making tools.

title: World's Largest Hackathon Kickoff — Bangalore
description: Official kickoff meetup for the World's Largest Hackathon by Bolt.new, happening in Bengaluru. Meet fellow builders, discover project ideas, and dive into what Bolt can do. Venue TBA. Casual, community-first vibe.

title: Clay / Lovable Hackathon — Bangalore
description: In-person hackathon with Clay and Lovable at Bangalore. Build AI-powered GTM and CS automation tools. Clay and Lovable credits provided. Paid Clay workspace needed. Pre-event setup video shared with attendees.

title: Community Tech Meetups — India
description: Ongoing calendar of tech meetups across India curated by CommunityMeetups on Luma — covering cities like Delhi NCR, Pune, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Indore. Includes workshops, hackathons, and conferences. Browse and filter by city on lu.ma/CommunityMeetups.

title: NCSA Open Hackathon 2025
description: NVIDIA + NCSA virtual Open Hackathon. Hands-on GPU accelerated computing event — help scientists and engineers port, accelerate, and optimize applications using CPUs, GPUs, and AI tools. Expert mentor-guided. GPU cluster access provided. Open globally; NCSA/NAIRR-affiliated teams get priority.

title: TACC Open Hackathon 2025
description: NVIDIA + Texas Advanced Computing Center (TACC) hybrid Open Hackathon. Optimize real-world scientific applications for CPUs, GPUs, and modern supercomputing architectures. Mentor-paired teams get dedicated GPU cluster access.

title: PSC/CMU/Pitt Open Hackathon
description: Open Hackathon organized by Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center, Carnegie Mellon, and University of Pittsburgh in partnership with NVIDIA. Virtual event for computational scientists to port and optimize code on GPU clusters. Open to all globally.
